intro: These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the eCom Gliders website and the Amazon-related services offered by eCom Gliders LLC ("eCom Gliders," "we," "us," or "our"). By browsing the site, submitting a form, accepting a proposal or invoice, or paying for services, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the site or engage our services.

sections.heading: 1. Agreement and parties
paragraphs: These Terms apply to website visitors and to clients who purchase or receive services from eCom Gliders. Where a signed proposal, statement of work, quote, or invoice sets specific commercial terms (fees, scope, timeline), that document and these Terms together form the agreement. If there is a direct conflict on fees or scope, the accepted proposal or invoice controls for that engagement; these Terms control on all other topics unless we agree otherwise in writing.

sections.heading: 2. Services we provide
paragraphs: eCom Gliders provides Amazon-focused agency services, which may include PPC and advertising management, listing optimization, content and creative support, catalog work, account operations, reporting, and related consulting. The services available may change over time. The current service list is described on our Services pages. The exact deliverables for your engagement are defined in the applicable proposal, statement of work, or written agreement.

sections.heading: 5. Refunds

If you are unsure which service fits your needs, contact us before purchasing or renewing.

sections.heading: 6. Term and cancellation

If you cancel early, you remain responsible for fees for work performed and fees accrued through the effective cancellation date. We may pause or end services immediately if these Terms are materially breached, if required access is withdrawn, or if payment remains outstanding after notice.
On ending an engagement, we will reasonably cooperate to hand back access and materials that belong to you, subject to payment of undisputed amounts owed.

After full payment for the relevant deliverables, you own the final client-specific materials delivered to you, except for our pre-existing tools, frameworks, processes, and generic templates, which remain eCom Gliders property.

You may use paid deliverables for your brand's Amazon and related commerce channels. You may not resell, redistribute, or reuse our unpaid work, internal tools, or frameworks as a competing agency offering without our written permission.
